tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Adverbs of manner say HOW: adjective + -ly. loud → loudly, careful → carefully, quiet → quietly, sad → sadly. -y → -ily: happy → happily. Irregular: fast → fast, good → well, hard → hard. Adjective describes a noun (a careful driver), the adverb describes a verb (he drives carefully).
tasks.q_pl: Adverbs of manner say HOW: adjective + -ly. loud → loudly, careful → carefully, quiet → quietly, sad → sadly. -y → -ily: happy → happily. Irregular: fast → fast, good → well, hard → hard. Adjective describes a noun (a careful driver), the adverb describes a verb (he drives carefully).
tasks.q_en: Adverbs of manner say HOW: adjective + -ly. loud → loudly, careful → carefully, quiet → quietly, sad → sadly. -y → -ily: happy → happily. Irregular: fast → fast, good → well, hard → hard. Adjective describes a noun (a careful driver), the adverb describes a verb (he drives carefully).

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: До Чикаго ще багато годин. А в цей час у темряві біля дому Кевіна з'являються знайомі фари. Північ уже минула. Бандити не забули свою обіцянку.
end_good.text_pl: Do Chicago jeszcze wiele godzin. A w tym czasie w ciemności przy domu Kevina pojawiają się znajome reflektory. Północ już minęła. Bandyci nie zapomnieli swojej obietnicy.
end_good.text_en: Chicago is still many hours away. Meanwhile, in the dark outside Kevin's house, familiar headlights appear. Midnight has passed. The bandits haven't forgotten their promise.
